site.title: Fernhill Back Office | Bookkeeping and payroll teams for UK firms
site.description: Fernhill Back Office runs bookkeeping, payroll and accounts payable teams for UK accounting practices and their clients.

data.title: Bookkeeping and payroll teams for *UK accounting firms*
data.lead: Fernhill Back Office runs bookkeeping, payroll and accounts payable work for UK practices, inside the software each practice already uses.

head.title: Solutions for every kind of practice
head.lead: Browse by the work you want to hand over, by the size of your firm or by the sector your clients work in.

photo.alt: Hands on a calculator in front of a laptop showing an accounting app

items.title: Bookkeeping
items.text: Bank reconciliations, sales and purchase ledgers and month-end checks, done in Xero, QuickBooks or Sage to your practice checklist.

photo.alt: A person at a wooden desk reading printed documents

items.title: Payroll
items.text: Weekly and monthly payroll runs, starters and leavers, pension submissions and payslips. A second processor checks each run before sign-off.

photo.alt: Man in a brown jacket signing papers beside a laptop

items.title: Accounts payable
items.text: Supplier invoices coded, matched to purchase orders and queued for approval. You get an aged creditors report every week.

photo.alt: Calculator, pens and an orange folder on a wooden desk

items.title: Year-end support
items.text: Working papers, fixed asset registers and draft accounts prepared for review by your qualified staff.

items.title: Sole practitioners
items.text: One part-time processor who takes the routine ledgers off your desk during the busy months.

items.title: Small firms
items.text: A shared team of two or three processors working to one checklist. One named reviewer checks your files.

items.title: Mid-size practices
items.text: A dedicated team with its own lead, split by service line. The lead reports to your practice manager each week.

items.title: Large practices
items.text: Several teams across bookkeeping, payroll and year-end. Capacity is planned against your deadline calendar.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Bookkeeping and payroll for dental and GP practices, including locum pay and associate statements.

items.title: Retail
items.text: Daily takings, stock purchases and card settlements reconciled for shops on one or several sites.

items.title: Hospitality
items.text: Tronc, tips and shift-based payroll for restaurants and hotels, plus weekly labour cost reports.

items.title: Construction
items.text: CIS returns, subcontractor payments and job costing for builders and trades firms.

steps.title: Share your checklist
steps.text: Send the ledgers, payrolls and deadlines you want to hand over and the software you use.

steps.title: Meet your team
steps.text: We name the processors and the reviewer who will work on your files and agree the weekly routine.

steps.title: Start on live work
steps.text: The team works inside your software and sends a status report to your practice manager every Friday.

aside.title: Have a question about your files?
aside.text: Our practice lead can walk you through the handover for your ledgers and payrolls.

items.q: Which software does the team use?
items.a: The team works in the software your practice already uses. Tell us which packages you run and we staff the team for them.
A named reviewer checks each file before it goes back to you. Your own staff sign off the final accounts.

items.q: Can we start with one service?
items.a: Yes. Most practices start with bookkeeping or payroll and add other work once the routine is settled.
Documents come through the portal or shared folders your practice already uses. The team does not ask clients to change how they send paperwork.

data.title: Talk to Fernhill about *your workload*
data.text: Tell us which ledgers and payrolls you run and when your deadlines fall. We reply with a team plan.

data.blurb: Fernhill Back Office runs bookkeeping, payroll and accounts payable teams for UK accounting practices.
